verdict.rationale: Mercury ships a documented REST API (accounts, transactions, invoices, treasury, webhooks), OAuth2 programmatic auth, and a verified official CLI (mercury-cli) that developers can build against, plus an llms.txt index explicitly for AI agents. However, there is no evidence of language-specific official SDKs (Python/JS/Node client libraries), and a probe for a formal OpenAPI spec file returned 404 on all standard paths, so 'OpenAPI' access is only implied via docs pages rather than a downloadable machine spec. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages in mainstream languages, a verifiable OpenAPI/swagger spec file, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
